sources.title: ZipVoice
sources.snippet: Abstract Existing large-scale zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) models deliver high speech quality but suffer from slow inference speeds due to massive parameters. To address this issue, this paper introduces ZipVoice, a high-quality flow-matching-based zero-shot TTS model with a compact model size and fast inference speed. sources.title: ZipVoice: Text-to-Audio model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview ZipVoice is a non-autoregressive zero-shot text-to-speech model built by k2-fsa that uses flow matching to generate high-quality speech from text input. The model family consists of two main variants: ZipVoice for single-speaker speech generation and ZipVoice-Dialog for multi-speaker dialogue synthesis.
